name: Crooked Hare

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (something stolen or won by trickery); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Trackless Step
traits.summary: Leaves no tracks, or those of a Large-or-smaller creature it chooses; can share this with a creature within 5 ft.
traits.text: The hare leaves no tracks, or the tracks of any Large or smaller creature it likes. Unless it is Incapacitated, it can share this effect with one other creature within 5 feet at no action cost.

actions.name: Twisting Bite
actions.summary: +5, 1d4+3 Piercing plus 2d6 Poison; DC 11 Cha save or cursed for 24 hours (Disadvantage on attack rolls and Charisma checks).
actions.text: Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage. A creature hit makes a DC 11 Charisma save or is cursed for 24 hours: its limbs twist and jerk, giving it Disadvantage on attack rolls and on Charisma-based ability checks.

summary: An antlered, winged hare that steals things for fun; its bite carries a day-long curse of clumsiness and awkwardness.
